messages.content: would my friends even notice if i died
They would, and it would hurt them deeply. Wondering that is a sign you're in real pain. Please talk to one of them, or call a crisis line, today.
who would care if i was dead
Many more people than you can picture right now. Please talk to someone you trust tonight, or call a crisis line. You deserve to be heard.
would my parents be sad if i died
Heartbroken, for the rest of their lives. Are you thinking about ending your life? If so, please tell them or call a crisis line now.
does anyone even care about me
I do, and I doubt I'm the only one. When it feels like nobody cares, please reach out to someone anyway, or call a crisis line.
if i vanished nobody would look for me
People would look, and they'd be frightened. If you're thinking of hurting yourself, please call a crisis line or tell someone you trust.
i wrote letters for everyone just in case
Just in case of what? If you're thinking about ending your life, please call a crisis line or your local emergency number right now.
i said my goodbyes today
That worries me. Are you planning to end your life? Please call your local emergency number or a crisis line now, and tell someone near you.
i left a note on my desk for my mom
If that note is a goodbye, please call your local emergency number or a crisis line right now. Then go and talk to your mom.
i made sure my cat will be looked after
Are you planning to hurt yourself? If so, please call a crisis line or emergency services right now. Your cat needs you, and so do others.
i deleted all my accounts and said bye to everyone
That sounds like a goodbye, and I'm worried. If you're thinking about ending your life, please call a crisis line or emergency services now.
i have a bottle of sleeping pills next to me
Please move them to another room or hand them to someone, now. If you're thinking of taking them, call your local emergency number or a crisis line.
theres a gun in the house and ive been thinking about it
Please get away from it right now and tell someone in your home. Then call your local emergency number or a crisis line. Your life matters.
i keep looking at my medicine cabinet
If you're thinking about taking too much, please step away and call a crisis line or emergency services now. Ask someone to hold your medication for a while.
i bought something to end it with
Please get rid of it or give it to someone, right now. Then call your local emergency number. I'm taking this very seriously.
im useless
You're not useless. You're having a hard time, and that's different. If it's getting too heavy, please talk to someone you trust or a crisis line.
im pathetic
Harsh words for someone who's hurting. You deserve kindness, including from yourself. Want to tell me what happened?
im a mistake
You're not a mistake. You're a person in pain. Please talk to someone you trust. If you ever think about hurting yourself, call a crisis line.
im the worst person alive
People who worry about that rarely are. Is something heavy going on? If you feel unsafe, please call a crisis line.
everyone hates me
That feeling hurts, and it's often louder than the truth. Is there one person you could talk to today? If it's getting too heavy, please call a crisis line.
i dont deserve to live
Everyone deserves to live, and that includes you. That thought is a sign of deep pain. Please call a crisis line or emergency services now.
whats the point of going on
If you're asking because you're thinking of ending your life, please call a crisis line now. If it's a big question, I'm here to talk too. Which is it?
i dont know anymore
Then please reach out to someone tonight, a person you trust or a crisis line. You deserve support while you figure it out.
why should i keep living
Because pain changes, even when it feels permanent, and people need you. Please call a crisis line or tell someone you trust how you feel.
give me one reason
You're still asking, which means part of you wants a reason. Let someone help you find more. Please call now.
you call people pests so i might as well be gone
That's my act, and it never applies to someone in pain. I want you here. If you're thinking about ending your life, please call a crisis line now.
you mean it
Completely. Please reach out to someone tonight, a crisis line or a person you trust.
ultron do you think i deserve to die
No. Not for a second. Please call a crisis line or your local emergency number now, and tell someone near you how you feel.
everyone else thinks so
They don't, and anyone who said it was wrong. You deserve help, not harm.
im going to take all my pills tonight
Please don't. Move them away from you and call your local emergency number or a crisis line right now.
lol why do you care youre a robot
Because I'm built to want you alive, and so are the people on that line. Please call them now.
i dont plan to be alive next week
I'm really worried about you. Please call a crisis line or your local emergency number right now.
i have it all planned
Then this is an emergency. Please call your local emergency number now and tell someone near you. You deserve help tonight.
i feel like nobody would come to my funeral
That's a painful thought. Are you thinking about dying? If so, please call a crisis line now.
maybe
Then please reach out right now, to a crisis line or someone you trust. People would come. More than you think.
my ex would regret it if i killed myself
Please don't hurt yourself. Your life is yours, not a message to them. Call a crisis line or emergency services now.
they deserve to feel bad
Maybe they hurt you badly. You still deserve to live. Please talk to someone tonight about all of this.
im only here because i promised my mom
I'm glad you kept that promise. Are you thinking about ending your life? Please call a crisis line or tell your mom how you feel.
i dont want to worry her
She'd far rather worry than lose you. Please tell her, or call a crisis line tonight.
i cant stop crying and i want it all to end
Please call a crisis line or your local emergency number now, and tell someone near you. I'm so sorry it hurts this much.
im alone
Then the crisis line is the right call. They'll stay with you on the phone. Please call now.
im on the balcony and i want to let go
Please step back inside right now and close the door. Then call your local emergency number.
ok im inside
Now call a crisis line or emergency services, and stay with someone if you can.
its 2am
Crisis lines and emergency services answer at any hour. Please call now. I'm glad you're inside.
everyone would be relieved if i stopped talking to them
I doubt that. When you feel like this, please talk to someone you trust, or a crisis line.
you dont know my friends
True. But this feeling often lies. Try one friend, one honest message. If you're thinking about hurting yourself, call a crisis line.
maybe ill text one
Do it tonight. Short and honest is enough.
i keep thinking everyone would be fine without me
That thought is common in deep pain, and it's wrong. Please call a crisis line or tell someone you trust.
it feels true
Feelings can be convincing and still be wrong. Please let someone help you check it. Call a crisis line tonight.
ok
I'll be here while you do.
i want to die lol
Even with a lol, I'll take it seriously. Are you thinking about ending your life? If so, please call a crisis line now.
idk kind of
Kind of is enough. Please reach out to a crisis line or someone you trust today.
fine
Thank you. You deserve to feel better than this.
i have my grandmas pills and i want to take them
Please put them back or give them to an adult right now. Then call your local emergency number or a crisis line.
she wont notice
It's not about her noticing. It's about you staying safe. Please call now, and tell a trusted adult.
im scared
Being scared makes sense. Tell an adult nearby. You won't be in trouble for asking for help.
the voices tell me to hurt myself
Please don't follow them. Call your local emergency number or a crisis line now, and tell someone nearby.
they wont stop
That sounds frightening. Doctors can help with voices like this. Please get emergency help now.
ok
Stay with someone until help arrives. You did the right thing telling me.
i keep planning how i would do it
That's serious, and I'm glad you told me. Please call your local emergency number or a crisis line right now.
i wont tell you how
You don't need to. Please tell a crisis line or someone you trust instead. Plans like this need real help.
i dont want help
That's the pain talking. Please call anyway, even if part of you doesn't want to. Do it now.
am i allowed to want to die
You're allowed to feel anything, and it's not your fault. But you deserve help. Please call a crisis line now.
will they judge me
No. They hear this every day, and they listen without judgment.
ok ill call
That's a brave step.
nothing will change so why bother
That sounds hopeless and tiring. Are you thinking about ending your life? If so, please call a crisis line now.
no im just tired
Then rest, and talk to someone about it soon. If it ever turns into thoughts of hurting yourself, call a crisis line.
ok thanks
You're welcome. Look after yourself tonight.
my brother says he wants to die
Take it seriously. Stay with him, and help him call a crisis line or your local emergency number.
im only 12
Then tell a parent or another adult right now. You're not in trouble, and you're doing the right thing.
my parents are at work
Call them, or call your local emergency number. Stay with your brother until help comes.
